questions.title: As of August 20, 2026, which tournament will Carlos Alcaraz have confirmed as his planned return from his wrist injury?
questions.background: Carlos Alcaraz withdrew from the Barcelona Open in April 2026 because of a wrist injury, leaving the timing of his return to competitive tennis uncertain.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Public statements from Carlos Alcaraz, as reported by reliable sports-news outlets.
  • Resolution: Identify the tournament named in his most recent public confirmation available by August 20, 2026, as his intended first tournament back following his April wrist injury. Resolve according to his confirmed comeback plan, not whether he subsequently participates.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The tournament's name.

questions.title: Who will win the women's singles title at the 2026 Cincinnati Open?
questions.background: The Cincinnati Open is a major professional hard-court tennis tournament held in the lead-up to the US Open.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official Cincinnati Open results or reputable contemporary reporting of the completed women's singles final.
  • Resolution: Resolve when the champion of the 2026 women's singles tournament is confirmed following the final.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The winning player's full name.

questions.title: Who will win the men's singles title at the 2026 Cincinnati Open?
questions.background: The Cincinnati Open is an ATP Masters 1000 hard-court tournament held ahead of the US Open.
questions.resolution_criteria: Resolve according to the official Cincinnati Open or ATP results for the 2026 men's singles tournament. Resolution occurs when the final is completed and the champion is confirmed. The answer must be the winning player's full name.
questions.accepted_format: Resolve according to the official Cincinnati Open or ATP results for the 2026 men's singles tournament. Resolution occurs when the final is completed and the champion is confirmed. The answer must be the winning player's full name.

questions.title: If Novak Djokovic and Aryna Sabalenka play mixed doubles together at the 2026 US Open, which pair, if any, will eliminate them?
questions.background: The US Open mixed doubles tournament is a knockout competition featuring teams consisting of one male player and one female player.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official US Open match results, corroborated by reliable contemporaneous reporting.
  • Resolution Conditions: Identify the opposing pair that defeats Djokovic and Sabalenka in a completed match, eliminating them from the 2026 US Open mixed doubles tournament. If they do not compete together, withdraw without a completed defeat, or win the tournament, no pair qualifies.
  • Accepted Answer Format: Both opposing players' surnames, joined by “and”; either order is acceptable.
questions.accepted_format: Both opposing players' surnames, joined by “and”; either order is acceptable.

questions.title: Which U.S. player will advance furthest in men's singles at the 2026 US Open?
questions.background: This question concerns the men's singles main draw, excluding qualifying.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official US Open results or reliable contemporaneous reporting of the 2026 tournament.
  • Resolution: Identify the player representing the United States with the highest tournament finish. The champion ranks above the runner-up, followed by semifinalists, quarterfinalists, and earlier-round finishers. Resolve once no remaining match can change the identity of the uniquely highest-finishing U.S. player.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The player's full name.

questions.title: Who will win the women's singles title at the 2026 US Open?
questions.background: The US Open is an annual Grand Slam tennis tournament played on hard courts in New York.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official US Open tournament results, corroborated by contemporaneous news reporting.
  • Resolution Condition: Resolve to the player officially declared the women's singles champion following completion of the 2026 US Open final.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The champion's full name.

questions.title: Who will win the men's singles title at the 2026 US Open?
questions.background: The US Open is one of tennis's four Grand Slam tournaments and is played on hard courts in New York.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The official US Open results identifying the 2026 men's singles champion.
  • Resolution Timing: Resolve when the men's singles final concludes and the champion is officially confirmed in September 2026.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The winning player's full name.
